docker-compose.description: Exclude the example compose file from Renovate. Scoped under the docker-compose manager rather than set at top level: a top-level ignorePaths REPLACES the list inherited from :ignoreModulesAndTests (node_modules, vendor, tests, etc.) instead of merging with it

customManagers.description: Track NUT (Network UPS Tools) releases from GitHub
matchStrings: # NUT version to build from source\s+ARG NUT_VERSION=(?<currentValue>.*?)\n

customManagers.description: Make the build matrix's `runner:` labels visible to Renovate. The built-in github-actions manager extracts runner labels from literal `runs-on:` values ONLY -- it does not traverse strategy.matrix.include[] (confirmed in doc-scanner #209). Without this manager a runner-image bump updates every other job in the repo and silently leaves the native per-arch build legs behind, shipping a split-brain build that still passes CI because both images work. The pattern captures only the numeric version, so the `-arm` suffix on the arm64 leg falls outside the match and survives the replace untouched; that is also why one matchString covers both legs. depName `ubuntu` and docker versioning match what the built-in manager emits, so these deps group into the same branch/PR as the `runs-on:` ones rather than opening a second.

packageRules.description: Alpine apk pins are extracted by Renovate's built-in dockerfile manager (>= 44.96.0) as datasource `apk`; the :alpine preset supplies the grouping, rangeStrategy and automerge posture but stays release-line agnostic, so this URL is the ONE place the Alpine release line is written. Bump `branch=v3.24` when the base image crosses a release line (3.24 -> 3.25). `components=main,community` merges both indexes in a single lookup (registryStrategy 'merge'), so community packages need no separate registryUrls override.

NUT source version — manual review on every bump, whatever the update type. The image builds NUT from source, so a bump is a rebuild, not a tag swap. Commit type is left to the fleet baseline (`deps:` => patch release); the rule below re-types the bumps that deserve more.

The ONE `feat:` in this repo's Renovate surface, and a deliberate exception to the fleet rule that no dependency update is ever typed `feat:` (see owine/renovate-config's README). It holds here because this repo is a packaging shim: its whole output is NUT, so the version a user runs IS this dependency's version — the question Renovate can't normally answer ("is this bump consumer-visible?") has a fixed answer of yes. Scoped to minor/major only so an upstream PATCH stays `deps:` (patch release) instead of cutting a minor here: the wrapper's semver then tracks upstream's own update type rather than drifting a digit ahead of it. Not `feat!:` on major — an upstream major is not automatically breaking for this image's users.
